note: Four campsites spaced among pines between the boat launch and the day-use loop at the end of the road, on 44-acre Fourche Lake (electric motors only). Reached from Route V by about a mile of the area's own road. The Forest Service gives no rig length. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: FS page free, Jan-Dec, 4 sites (tables, fire rings, lantern posts), vault toilet, no potable water; no rec.gov listing -> FCFS. Lake is 44 acres. FS photo 'Fourche Lake view from campsite' shows a filtered lake view -> waterfront lead not waterfront -> lakeview. Phone 573-996-2153 (district) to add. Note corrected (road distance).
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (not waterfront -> lakeview): the FS page says the lake is 44 acres (over the 5-acre pond line), and its only photo is titled 'Fourche Lake view from campsite': a picnic table under pines with the lake and the fishing pier visible through the trunks across mown grass - a filtered view from a campsite in an official photo, which the 2026-11-01 rule makes enough for *view. On-water is not supported: the sites are 'spaced out among the trees' between the launch and the day-use loop; on imagery (Overpass did not answer, so distances are imagery estimates) the pine stand holding them is ~50-80 m from the shoreline, with mown day-use grass and the pier path between.
PHONE (none stored): FS page 'Eleven Point/Doniphan Ranger District ... Phone: 573-996-2153'. Add it (apply.py doesn't write phones).

ROAD/FIT: FS directions: 'Take U.S. HWY 160 approx 15.7 miles west and turn left onto V Hwy. Stay on V Hwy approx. 2.5 miles until you see the sign for Fourche Lake on the left. The road ends at the site, approximately 1 one [mile].' So the 2.5 miles the note called gravel is state Route V; the area road is ~1 mile. 'Separate Boat Parking near boat launch for 7 vehicles with trailers'. The current page has no rig length, no 4WD or high-clearance wording and no 'large units' wording. The stored inclusion_evidence quotes "'large units not recommended'", but that text is not on the current FS page and no source for it was found (an older FS page was not found on Wayback) - if AWH knows its source, it would be explicit rig wording; otherwise the page is silent and the entry stays with the no-length caveat in the note.

PIN: stored 36.6388,-91.0578 sits in the day-use loop at the end of the road (toilet ~35 m NW), not in the campsites; FS's own point 36.638955,-91.056833 is at the shore by the pier. The campsites are under pine canopy south-west of the loop and can't be seen on imagery, so no corrected pin is offered; the pin is within ~100 m of them.
